protocols.profile: One frame header after an HTTP Upgrade boundary (reached by the websocket-upgrade shift or an explicit candidate); payload not decoded
Client command line (FTP-only verbs); shared USER/PASS/QUIT verbs are ambiguous with POP3 and resolved by session correlation with a 220 greeting
Server +OK/-ERR status line or POP3-only client command; shared verbs resolved by correlation
Two complete IAC option negotiation commands; terminal data not inspected
NetBIOS session header plus SMB_COM_NEGOTIATE request (dialect strings) or response (NT LM 0.12, LAN Manager or core layout; challenge and domain not emitted); maps to the smb application
NetBIOS session request with two first-level encoded names; names not emitted
KDC AS/TGS-REQ, AS/TGS-REP and KRB-ERROR ASN.1 framing (pvno 5, msg-type per tag, ordered fields, error code reported); principals, tickets and pre-authentication unverified and never emitted
TACACS+ header for the first two packets of a session (START seq 1, REPLY seq 2); body lengths and status codes checked when unencrypted, never emitted
Handshake initiation/response/cookie message sizes and reserved bytes; no key or tunnel claim; message type reported for both directions
Client or server hard-reset control packet (plain or tls-auth layout, server acknowledgement array and remote session id); no key exchange claim
Start-Control-Connection-Request (156 bytes); names not emitted; Start-Control-Connection-Reply with result code reported
L2TPv2 SCCRQ control message with Message Type AVP first; SCCRP with the peer's tunnel id, message kind reported
M-SEARCH/NOTIFY/response HTTPU header block with SSDP headers
NetFlow v5 record framing and NetFlow v9 flowsets (reported as netflow/5, netflow/9)
IPFIX (RFC 7011) message header and set framing, validated by the shared flow-export validator
sFlow v5 datagram with IPv4 agent and bounded sample headers
MBAP header with public function request PDU shapes, normal response shapes (byte count and data) and exception responses (code reported); transaction ids above 0x01ff need a hint
Data link frame with header and block CRCs verified
BVLC function/length and NPDU version/control framing
TPKT/X.224 connection request with TSAP parameters (RFC 1006); shares the TPKT route with RDP

One S7 PDU in a COTP data TPDU after the ISO-TSAP connection (reached by the cotp-connect shift or an explicit candidate): header, ROSCTR, public function codes, setup communication fields; addresses and values not decoded
Encapsulation header with RegisterSession/list/data commands; CIP not decoded
APCI U-format start frames automatically; I/S formats with a hint
Request header for ApiVersions/Metadata/Produce/Fetch/SaslHandshake and similar first requests
Cassandra native protocol v4 STARTUP/OPTIONS requests and ERROR/READY/AUTHENTICATE/SUPPORTED responses
Hint required: RTP v2 fixed header, CSRC and extension framing
QUIC v1/v2 Initial (client protection removed with public Initial keys; ClientHello SNI/ALPN as offers) and Version Negotiation; no handshake completion, server packets or 0-RTT

IKE_SA_INIT initiator or responder: bounded SA/KE/nonce, AES-CBC/GCM and MODP14..18 offers or the single selected proposal, optional CERTREQ and non-ESP marker; no authentication or established IPsec claim
DTLS1.2 complete epoch-zero ClientHello, HelloVerifyRequest or ServerHello in one record/datagram; bounded extensions, assertions only; no fragments, encrypted epochs or decryption
Connection-oriented v5.0 unfragmented Bind, Bind_ack (result list, accepted NDR 2.0/NDR64 1.0) and Bind_nak; no authentication, stub decoding or product identity
GIOP 1.2 unfragmented KeyAddr Request/LocateRequest and Reply/LocateReply (status reported); bounded CDR, opaque arguments, bodies and service contexts; no object identity

Native Git pkt-line service request; bounded pathname, optional DNS/IPv4 host and extra parameters; no packfile, server or negotiated-version validation; server ref advertisement (object id, refname, capabilities framed) or protocol v2 banner, message kind reported
Hint required: Access-Request PAP/CHAP/State, Access-Accept/Reject/Challenge with the attributes each code allows; code reported, no authenticator verification or EAP decoding
v1 BEGIN_REQUEST plus complete PARAMS stream; one request, zero reserved fields, no response/body semantics; application-server STDOUT/STDERR/END_REQUEST records, record kind reported
Daemon greeting, final protocols 27..32; version/digest offers, no authentication or transfer

MSSQL TDS 7.x PRELOGIN packet (client) or its response (server): header, option table, VERSION/ENCRYPTION mandatory, fixed option lengths; instance names, thread, trace and nonce bytes not emitted; no LOGIN7 or query stream

Oracle Net CONNECT (client) or ACCEPT/REFUSE/RESEND (server) packet: header checksums zero, versions 308..319, connect data offset/length consistency, printable descriptor; descriptor contents not emitted; no DATA packets or authentication

Hint required: server HandshakeV10 (21-byte challenge, native/caching_sha2/sha256 plugin), client SSLRequest or HandshakeResponse41 (capabilities, bounded user/database/plugin/attributes, plugin reported, names not emitted)
Hint required: uncompressed OP_MSG body/sequences, bounded BSON and CRC-32C; no telemetry or command semantics; request/reply direction reported from responseTo
1.1/1.2 CONNECT/STOMP/CONNECTED, complete empty-body NUL-terminated frame
INFO/CONNECT with required typed JSON fields; bounded extensions, no message bodies
Server CAPABILITY or OK/PREAUTH with explicit IMAP4rev1/2 capability; no commands/authentication
TPKT/X.224 with RDP negotiation, optional cookie/correlation; no routing token or session
BGPv4 OPEN, standard optional lengths and capability framing
Direct TCP SMB2/3 NEGOTIATE request (offers) or response (selected dialect, signing mode, 3.1.1 contexts); security token not emitted

v1/v2c and v3 messages with every standard PDU kind (Get, GetNext, GetBulk, Set, Response, Trap, Inform, Report; v3 USM header and plaintext or encrypted scoped PDU); PDU kind reported, values never emitted
RRQ/WRQ with bounded options; no transfer state; server OACK with the standard numeric options, ERROR with the tftp hint only (DATA/ACK too weak to identify), packet kind reported
Hint required: v3/v4 base client/server header, no extensions/authentication; mode (client/server) reported
HTTP/1.0 and 1.1 start-line/headers; method, content-type class and a dns-message accept reported
ONC RPC v2 CALL (program label, version, credential flavor; AUTH_NONE/AUTH_SYS structure) and REPLY (accept or reject status) over TCP last-fragment records or UDP; arguments and results not decoded
Capabilities-Exchange-Request/Answer on the base application: header flags, every AVP header, mandatory AVPs, Result-Code class; identities and product name not emitted
ZMTP 3.0/3.1 64-byte greeting (signature, version, mechanism, as-server flag, zero filler); mechanism and role reported
Neo4j Bolt handshake (magic, four version ranges) automatically; the four-byte server version response with the bolt hint
Client preface plus initial SETTINGS, then the first HEADERS block (HPACK decoded: method, scheme, authority host, content-type class; server :status)

ClientHello plus bounded TLS1.2/1.3 server hello/retry profiles; optional leaf-certificate structure after a TLS 1.2 ServerHello (`certificates`); encrypted_client_hello extension structure reported as `tls_ech`; selections unauthenticated, no decryption
Leading SSH-2.0/1.99 identification
Client no-auth offer plus request, or server method selection plus reply; subnegotiation and tunnel unverified
OPC UA TCP connection messages Hello, Acknowledge, Error and ReverseHello: little-endian size, buffer minimums, bounded printable opc.tcp URLs and reasons (not emitted); no secure channel
EHLO/HELO only; ambiguous 220 banners unknown
3.1.1/5.0 CONNECT; MQTT5 CONNECT/Will property validation
Non-null bulk-string request array; no product inference
Plain 0-9-1/1.0 version header only; broker Connection.Start frame (properties, mechanisms and locales framed, not emitted)

Query or response with QUERY opcode and one question, bounded record walk; message kind, rcode and question type class reported; TCP length prefixes >=512 require dns hint; multicast markers and NetBIOS questions over TCP keep the dns family with their evidence rows

Multicast DNS (RFC 6762) in the DNS layout: a .local name, a QU or cache-flush bit, several questions or an announcement without questions; queries may carry known answers and probe authority records, responses carry AA with rcode zero; profile reported (announcement, probe, known-answer, unicast-requested, plain); names and records never emitted

NetBIOS name service (RFC 1002): NB/NBSTAT questions with the 32-byte first-level encoded name, registration, release and refresh requests with one additional NB record, WACK and positive/negative responses; opcode, message kind, rcode and question type reported; names, addresses and node status never emitted

LLMNR (RFC 4795) with the llmnr hint only: opcode zero, one question, zero Z field, C/T flag semantics (conflict/tentative reported); the bytes are otherwise indistinguishable from a unicast DNS query; names never emitted
Binding method; attributes and optional fingerprint, no HMAC validation
DHCPv4 types 1..8, no overloaded options; operation and message type reported
CoAP v1 framing, token <=8; tiny messages require coap hint
RFC5424 version 1 header/structured data; no RFC3164; over TCP one RFC 6587 octet-counting or non-transparent frame
Client connection setup (byte order, protocol 11.0, bounded authorization name and data lengths; cookie never emitted); the server setup reply with the x11-server hint
SpiceLinkHeader 2.x with SpiceLinkMess (channel type, capability counts) or SpiceLinkReply (error, public key size, capability counts)
DSI GetStatus and OpenSession requests and replies (header fields, option types and lengths); AFP commands not inspected

Client registration lines (NICK with nickname grammar, CAP subcommands; USER with its four parameters is ambiguous with FTP and PASS with FTP/POP3) and server opening lines (':'-prefixed numeric replies, NOTICE, PING, CAP; unprefixed NOTICE AUTH/* and PING); message class reported, nicknames, hosts, channels and text never emitted
Omron FINS/TCP node address request and reply, and the first FINS frame header (ICF, gateway count, address ranges); data not read
RIP v1/v2 request or response: zero field, 1..25 entries, address family, metric, v1 zero fields, v2 simple-password or MD5 authentication framing
Hint required: RTCP compound packet beginning with SR or RR, every packet length within the datagram
LIFX LAN header: size equals datagram, protocol 1024, addressable, origin 0, target layout, payload size of known message types
Tuya LAN 3.3 frame: 0x000055AA prefix, length, CRC32 over header and payload, 0x0000AA55 suffix; payload not decrypted
TP-Link Smart Home: XOR autokey 171 printable JSON object, nesting <= 8, documented module names only
RFC 6120 stream header in either direction (optional XML declaration, client/server/component namespace, version, to/from domain as hostname); features, STARTTLS and stanzas not inspected
v3.0..3.2 startup or SSL/GSS request (client); Authentication*, ErrorResponse and NegotiateProtocolVersion (server) with method, SQLSTATE class reported; salts, SASL data and messages not emitted
RFB 3.3/3.7/3.8 banner; no VNC security exchange
68-byte peer handshake; encrypted transport unsupported
Selected binary request commands 0x00..0x10; no SASL/text/meta; binary responses (status and sizes consistent with the command, status reported)

LDAPv3 BindRequest, simple/SASL, BindResponse, ExtendedRequest and ExtendedResponse (result code and extended operation class reported; a named StartTLS success response announces the ldap-starttls shift to TLS, the client direction is opened by host correlation on the same message id; DN, diagnostic, SASL credentials and extended values not emitted); no controls or searches
SIP/2.0 required header framing; no dialogue/body semantics
RTSP/1.0 and 2.0 header framing; no RTP/media decoding
